All 14 queries ran and gave sensible answers. I checked T12 and T13 by hand against `orders.csv`, and both matched. T1 gave 4, T4 gave 33.17 and T11 gave 330.2.

One thing to know: map keys are keywords in qlang. T8 and T13 therefore turn them into strings with `keyword`.

T1: | /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(/email | ne null) | filter ~(/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: | /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
T3: | /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)
T4: | /data/users | map ~(at :profile | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels | map ~(/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | at :login)})
T7: | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count)
T8: | [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | map ~([(/0 | keyword) "@" /1] | join "")
T9: | /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: | lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) | map ~(count)
T11: | lines | map ~(split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: | lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | map ~([(/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)] | reduce 1 ~(mul)) | sum | round 2
T13: | lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) | map ~(map ~([(/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)] | reduce 1 ~(mul)) | sum | round 2) | entries | sort ~(/1 | desc) | take 2 | map ~({:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1})
